title: A tour of the Crewflow web console
subtitle: Dashboard, users, venues, shifts, offers, calendar and payroll

captions.text: The dashboard shows your staff, offers and venues at a glance.
Users lists your staff and managers.
Venues holds every site you staff, with its address and pay rates.
Shifts shows every shift, how many places are filled and its status.
Offers tracks each offer you have sent and how staff responded.
The calendar shows the month ahead. Select a day to see its shifts.
Payroll lists worked hours and earnings from completed attendance.
